summary: Final polish sprint to take SpendCube from working prototype to client-ready state. Fixes all 4 failing tests (3 in test_ingestion.py due to sample.csv invoice number mismatches, 1 in backend due to missing batch_id in mock), eliminates deprecation warnings, adds a no-data empty state to OverviewPage, creates an automated evaluation harness script for procurement opportunity assessment quality checks, enhances the synthetic test data generator with realistic procurement scenarios, and writes a comprehensive HANDOVER.md document covering full setup, deployment, and first-engagement walkthrough.

decisions.sample_csv_redesign: Update data/input/sample.csv invoice numbers to match test expectations rather than updating tests — the tests correctly describe the intended semantics (credit note detection, intercompany flagging, FX conversion); the CSV was regenerated with different invoice numbers
decisions.evaluation_harness_location: scripts/evaluate_pipeline.py — runnable standalone with python3 scripts/evaluate_pipeline.py, uses a temp SQLite DB so it leaves no side effects on production data
decisions.handover_document: HANDOVER.md at project root — separate from DEPLOYMENT.md (deployment steps only); covers architecture, local dev, Supabase migrations in order, Railway + Vercel deploy, first engagement walkthrough, troubleshooting
decisions.no_data_empty_state: OverviewPage detects when total_spend == 0 AND month data is empty AND loading is complete, then renders an empty-state card with a link to the Upload page — sits above the KPI grid, does not replace it
decisions.deprecation_fixes: Fix both pandas select_dtypes and datetime.utcnow warnings — use select_dtypes(include=['object', 'string']) for pandas 2/3/4 compatibility and datetime.now(timezone.utc) for UTC timestamps

userStories.title: Fix backend test failure — add batch_id to _MOCK_JOB
userStories.description: The test backend/tests/test_ingestion_api.py::TestStatus::test_get_status_known_job_returns_row fails with KeyError: 'batch_id'. The get_job_status router in backend/app/routers/ingestion.py (around line 138) reads row['batch_id'] from the SQL SELECT result. The _MOCK_JOB dict in the test file (around line 30) was written before batch_id was added to the pipeline_jobs table in the Data Model Hardening sprint. The fix is to add 'batch_id': None to _MOCK_JOB so the mock mapping returns None for that key.

userStories.title: Fix deprecation warnings in cleaner.py and ingest.py
userStories.description: Two deprecation warnings appear across the test run. First, src/ingestion/cleaner.py has two calls to df.select_dtypes(include=['object']) (at approximately lines 176 and 182) that trigger Pandas4Warning. The forward-compatible fix is select_dtypes(include=['object', 'string']). Second, src/ingestion/ingest.py calls datetime.utcnow() (approximately line 144) which is deprecated since Python 3.12. Fix by importing timezone from datetime and changing to datetime.now(timezone.utc).

userStories.title: Create evaluation harness — scripts/evaluate_pipeline.py
userStories.description: Create scripts/evaluate_pipeline.py — a standalone quality-gate script for validating pipeline output before client delivery. When run with no arguments it generates 200-row synthetic data and runs the full pipeline on a temp SQLite DB. When run with --csv path/to/file.csv it uses that file instead. The script prints a structured 5-section report with PASS/WARN/FAIL verdicts. It must add the project root to sys.path so it can import from src/ (use: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..')) at the top).
acceptanceCriteria: Create file: scripts/evaluate_pipeline.py
Script adds project root to sys.path before any src/ imports
Script accepts --csv (optional, path to CSV file) and --db (optional, SQLite path; default tempfile that is deleted after run)
If --csv not provided: generate 200 rows using src/utils/generate_test_data.py GenerateTestData or the generate_data() function, write to a temp CSV, use that

Run pipeline phases in order: (1) Ingestor(config).ingest_to_db(csv_path, engine) from src/ingestion/ingest.py, (2) SupplierHarmoniser(engine, config).harmonise() from src/suppliers/harmoniser.py, (3) SpendCategoriser(engine, config).categorise() from src/categorisation/categoriser.py, (4) run_pipeline(engine, config) from src/cube/pipeline.py, (5) RecommendationEngine(db_path).run() from src/recommendations/engine.py

Print 5-section report: Section 1 Ingestion (row_count, credit_notes, intercompany_filtered), Section 2 Supplier Harmonisation (canonical_suppliers, high_pct, medium_pct, low_pct, unmatched), Section 3 Categorisation (coverage_pct = rows with confidence>=0.60 / total, high_pct, medium_pct, low_pct, uncategorised), Section 4 Recommendations (count, types list, total_savings_aud, sanity_check_passed), Section 5 Data Quality (each check name, status, value_pct)
Show verdict per metric: coverage_pct >= 0.70 → PASS, >= 0.50 → WARN, < 0.50 → FAIL; recommendation count >= 3 → PASS, >= 1 → WARN, 0 → FAIL; sanity_check_passed true → PASS, false → FAIL
Run: python3 scripts/evaluate_pipeline.py 2>&1 | tail -30 — must complete without uncaught exception and print a report containing at least one PASS verdict

userStories.description: Update src/utils/generate_test_data.py to produce more realistic procurement data. The existing currencies, pay terms variants, and GL ranges should be preserved.

userStories.title: Write comprehensive HANDOVER.md
userStories.description: Create HANDOVER.md at the SpendCube project root — the primary document for a consultant taking over SpendCube to run it for a client. It is separate from DEPLOYMENT.md (which covers only deployment steps). HANDOVER.md is written for a non-developer with basic command-line skills. It must cover: what SpendCube does, the full stack architecture in plain English, prerequisites checklist, local development (3 commands to get running), Supabase setup including the pgvector extension and the exact order of the 3 migrations (001_initial_schema.sql then 002_analytics_extensions.sql then 003_data_model_hardening.sql), Railway and Vercel deployment, a complete environment variables reference table for both services, a step-by-step first engagement walkthrough, how to run the evaluation harness (scripts/evaluate_pipeline.py), and a troubleshooting section.
acceptanceCriteria: Create file: HANDOVER.md at the project root (same level as CLAUDE.md, DEPLOYMENT.md)

Document contains these top-level sections (in order): ## Overview, ## Architecture, ## Prerequisites, ## Local Development, ## Supabase Setup, ## Backend Deployment (Railway), ## Frontend Deployment (Vercel), ## Environment Variables Reference, ## First Engagement Walkthrough, ## Running the Evaluation Harness, ## Troubleshooting

Supabase Setup section includes: enable pgvector extension SQL (CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;), and applies migrations in order 001 → 002 → 003 with the npx supabase db push command or manual SQL editor instructions
Environment Variables Reference section is a markdown table with columns: Variable | Service | Required | Description — covering all variables from DEPLOYMENT.md plus ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DRY_RUN

First Engagement Walkthrough has 5 numbered steps: 1 Create engagement via UI, 2 Upload CSV on Upload page, 3 Wait for pipeline completion (poll /ingest/status), 4 View Overview dashboard, 5 Review Recommendations page

Troubleshooting section covers at least these 5 issues: pgvector extension missing, CORS error on API calls, JWT validation failure, pipeline job stuck in 'queued', empty dashboard after successful upload
